kamloops.title: B.C. family rescues exhausted baby bear swimming in Okanagan Lake
kamloops.description: Christina Zamniuk says they were boating between their Vernon lakehouse and Adventure Bay last weekend when a baby bear was spotted swimming in the middle of the lake.

southeast.title: Skunk rabies case prompts public warning in B.C. Interior
southeast.description: Health officials in B.C. are warning people in the Kooteney Lake region to avoid contact with skunks after one animal recently tested positive for rabies.

all.title: How drones can better integrate with total incident response
all.description: By Usama Mehboob Wildfire drone operations have moved beyond the question of whether an unmanned aircraft can find heat or provide an overhead view. The harder problem is fitting another aircraft and another stream of data into an incident that may already involve helicopters, air tankers, lead planes, ground crews and changing airspace restrictions. all.title: Prescribed burning gets hazard pay coverage under final rule passage
all.description: The U.S. Wildland Fire Service celebrated what it called a “well-deserved win” for the nation’s firefighters after prescribed wildland fire duties were officially made eligible for hazardous duty pay.
